name: fermos_mcp
schema: openferment_core (packages/core) — canonical Pydantic models; nothing is hand-written here

tools.name: health
tools.note: corpusSnapshotId is a sha256 digest of the corpus bytes read at startup, never a constant. The framing is openferment_core.snapshot's, shared with every other server so that two servers reading the same file report the same id.

tools.name: get_scenario
tools.returns: envelope { data: Scenario | null, ..., notice? } — null carries a notice naming the miss

tools.name: submit_evaluation
tools.behaviour: validates the request shape, then refuses — no evaluator is wired up; no handle is issued

tools.name: get_evaluation
tools.behaviour: refuses — no evaluator is wired up; this backend has never issued a handle
